text:
Predicates:
PrivateUniversity(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeagueUniversity(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y, t) ::: x moved to location y at time t.
EndowmentValue(x, v) ::: x has an endowment valued at v.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x is organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
AtYale(x) ::: x is at Yale University.
Premises:
PrivateUniversity(yale) ∧ IvyLeagueUniversity(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven, 1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
EndowmentValue(yale, 42.3_billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(yale, {residentialColleges, yaleGraduateSchool, twelveProfessionalSchools}) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
ResidentialCollege(benjaminFranklin) ∧ AtYale(benjaminFranklin) ::: Benjamin Franklin College is a residential college at Yale.
ResidentialCollege(berkeley) ∧ AtYale(berkeley) ::: Berkeley College is a residential college at Yale.

ResidentialCollege(pierson) ∧ AtYale(pierson) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.

ResidentialCollege(silliman) ∧ AtYale(silliman) ::: Silliman College is a residential college at Yale.
ResidentialCollege(timothyDwight) ∧ AtYale(timothyDwight) ::: Timothy Dwight College is a residential college at Yale.
ResidentialCollege(trumbull) ∧ AtYale(trumbull) ::: Trumbull College is a residential college at Yale.
Conclusion:
ResidentialCollege(pierson) ∧ AtYale(pierson) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
